eligibility.quote: kobuki.urdf.xacro just defines a component tag `<kobuki/>` that can be used by other xacros (e.g. turtlebot).
eligibility.reason: E1/E4: a maintainer reproduces the robot_state_publisher startup failure. E2: the model package and consuming node are separate units, and the expanded model supplied across robot_description lacks the required links. The fix creates a standalone model instantiating the macro, changing the supplied content rather than only binding deployment names. E3: PAIR describes this parameter-value flow.

failed_conditions.quote: No link elements found in urdf file
failed_conditions.reason: The wrong structural content of robot_description is not a nominal type, definition-version, frame, unit, or QoS mismatch; other is appropriate. The new launcher explicitly writes this parameter.

loudness.quote: Failed to extract kdl tree from xml robot description
loudness.reason: The consumer emits an explicit startup validation error and dies: loud_documented.

detection_stage.quote: all processes on machine have died, roslaunch will exit
detection_stage.reason: The error occurs while launching and initializing the consumer: activate.

resolution.quote: I've added a kobuki standalone xacro there now.
resolution.reason: The patch adds a wrapper that includes the component and instantiates <kobuki/>, plus a launcher. Neither the issue nor inspected patch demonstrates the resulting viewer composition running; recommended is supported.

notes: Read the full issue and the launch/model portions of the fix patch. This is not classified as deployment_wiring merely because a launcher changes: the standalone model content is also newly created. The parser and KDL error messages describe one malformed-model condition, not separate failures.
